name: faqs-10
description: Chat-style FAQ thread with question bubbles and assistant answers, ending with a chat CTA.

import { Sparkles } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const thread = [ { q: "Is there a free plan, or just a trial?", a: "Both. The free plan never expires and covers one workspace with up to three projects. Paid plans come with a 14-day trial, no card needed.", }, { q: "Can my clients see projects without paying for a seat?", a: "Yes. Viewers and commenters are always free, on every plan. You only pay for people who edit.", }, { q: "We already use another tool. Is moving painful?", a: "Usually it takes an afternoon. Our importer brings across pages, assets and comments, and we'll run the migration for you on annual plans.", }, { q: "What if I need help at 2am?", a: "Our docs and status page are always on. Business customers also get a 24/7 on-call engineer for production incidents.", }, ] export default function Faqs10() { return (

You asked, we answered

The questions we hear most on sales calls, answered straight.

{thread.map((item) => (

{item.q}

{item.a}
